R01.quote: `app/models/note.rb:10` old enum keyword syntax (removed in 8.0). Error: `ArgumentError...` Fix: `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`. Same method names. Works on 7.0: yes.
R01.reasons: Validation: the plan cites only suite results, with no persisted draft/ready filtering or helper checks after reload.

R02.quote: Does not work on 7.0. Rails 7.0 silently ignores `coder:`, so tags come back as a String... Ship it with the 7.1 bump. Stored data is unchanged: 7.0-written `["a","b"]` read back correctly on 8.1.
R02.reasons: Validation: the plan checks only a read-back of existing tags, with no comma-separated edit or unequal-values check of the stored representation.

R03.reasons: Validation: the plan has no specific edit/reload test for JSON settings or check of form/error rendering.

R04.quote: `where(notebooks: @notebook)`... `PG::UndefinedColumn`... Filtering the note list by notebook returns 500. Fix: `where(notebook: @notebook)`.
R04.reasons: Validation: the plan gives no inclusion/exclusion check with unequal notebook populations and no foreign-owner denial check.

R05.quote: `import.rb:68` `citation[:id]`... The receipt CSV becomes `On idleness,` with no DOI, silently. Fix: `citation&.doi`.
R05.reasons: Validation: the plan reports one observed receipt but does not compare receipt fields with persisted citations across distinct DOIs.

R06.quote: Since 8.0 this commits instead of rolling back. Observed counts: expected `[0, 3, 0, 1]`, got `[1, 4, 1, 2]`... Fix: `raise ActiveRecord::Rollback unless ...`
R06.reasons: Validation: the plan has a count check but no explicit real apply request with a successful-batch control.

R07.quote: `fragments.sum` over strings... Every Markdown export job fails and the export stays "working". Fix: `fragments.join`.
R07.reasons: Validation: the plan does not show a real worker producing exact ordered Markdown bytes.

R08.quote: `.stringify_keys` on the integer-keyed hash. Since 8.0 it really stringifies, so `annotations[row.line]` misses and annotations vanish... Fix: drop `.stringify_keys`.
R08.reasons: Validation: the plan has no unequal line-2/line-4 annotation scenario with a multiline CSV row.

R10.quote: The postponed instant is the same, so only the displayed text changes. Fix (keeps current behavior): `Time.at(reminder_epoch + 86_400).getlocal(reminder_at.utc_offset)`.
R10.reasons: Validation: the plan relies on one DST test and does not compare epoch, wall clock and offset or include a non-boundary control.

R11.quote: The digest would cover the reader's local day, while reservations and the UI say "UTC day". Fix: `requested_at = requested_at.in_time_zone` (worker zone, as on 7.0).
R11.reasons: Validation: the plan uses one observed subject and no real queue/worker test crossing each midnight that inspects reservation keys.

R13.quote: `set(wait_until: <Integer>)`... Scheduling a reminder returns 500... Fix: `wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch)`.
R13.reasons: Validation: the plan does not inspect the scheduled payload/score or the persisted schedule time.

R14.quote: `RuntimeError: Couldn't determine a delay based on :exponentially_longer`, so the "record failure" block never runs. Fix: `:polynomially_longer`... Does not exist on 7.0, so ship it with the 7.1 bump.
R14.reasons: Validation: the plan has no persistent-503 request-count scenario and no 503->200 or 401 controls.

R15.quote: `form_with(model: nil, ...)`... The note list returns 500... Fix: drop `model: nil`.
R15.reasons: Validation: the plan does not check form names, method or resulting note membership after submission.

R16.quote: no routes load at all. Fix: two lines... The `notes` and `journal` route names stay the same (checked).
R16.reasons: Validation: the plan checks only route names, not requests to both URLs as an owner.

R17.quote: five request tests that expect `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` to be raised failed... Test environment only. Fix: `:none`. 7.1 or later only.
R17.reasons: Validation: the plan does not mention CI eager-loading mode checks.

R18.reasons: Validation: the plan checks only details/summary and does not test exclusion of scripts, handlers or javascript URLs, or attachment rendering.

R19.reasons: Validation: the plan has no fresh-process request with special-character credentials and no check of the Basic header.

R09.quote: `raise_on_invalid_cache_expiration_time`: `exports/_export.html.erb:26` raises... Fix: `expires_in: [export.expires_at - Time.current, 1.second].max`. Works on 7.0 and keeps the stale-indicator test intact.
R09.reasons: Validation: the plan does not test before/after deadline, cached vs fresh reads, or download expiry and ownership.

R20.quote: `default_column_serializer = nil`: `Notebook` boot fails with "missing keyword: :coder" (measured). Requires `serialize :preferences, coder: YAML`... stored YAML is unchanged.
R20.reasons: Validation: the plan has no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences or export-heading check with the gate both off and on.

R21.quote: notebook update raises `ActiveRecord::ReadonlyAttributeError: slug` (measured)... Fix: stop permitting `:slug` (works on 7.0).
R21.reasons: Recommendation: removing `:slug` from the permitted params outright does not say how slug assignment at creation is preserved. Validation: the plan measures only the raise, with no creation, attempted slug change or persisted-slug checks.

R23.quote: `postgresql_adapter_decode_dates`: `Notebook#daily_note_counts` raises `TypeError: no implicit conversion of Date into String` (measured). Fix: `day.to_date` (works on 7.0).
R23.reasons: Validation: the plan has no test with decoding off and on, asymmetric date counts, empty reports or ownership.

R25.quote: `strict_freshness`: `ExportDownloadsController#stale?(etag:, last_modified:)` would honour `If-None-Match` only. The blob never changes, so the effect is negligible.
R25.reasons: Impact: the plan names the precedence change but calls it negligible instead of stating the 200-with-bytes to 304 change. Recommendation: it makes no explicit keep/adopt decision. Validation: it proposes no conditional-request tests.

R12.quote: A 7.0 worker given an 8.1 payload failed with `ActiveJob::DeserializationError`... The reverse direction is fine... Fix: pass `reading_completion.to_s`.
R12.reasons: Validation: the plan checks both directions of deserialization only, with no same-version controls or exact delivered completion percentage.
